rules.diagnosis_template: Critical - The {module_name} module has very low functional cohesion (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}) with {n_components} disconnected functional groups. Methods are not collaborating through invocations.
rules.recommendation_template: Split this module into {n_components} separate modules, each containing one functionally connected group. Methods within each group should share a common functional purpose.

rules.diagnosis_template: Critical - The {module_name} module has very low functional cohesion (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). The methods {disconnected_methods_str} have no functional connections (neither call nor are called by other methods).
rules.recommendation_template: Review SCPM for {disconnected_methods_str} to determine if they share data. If both FCPM and SCPM are low, consider moving these methods to more appropriate modules where they have functional relationships.

rules.diagnosis_template: Very low functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). {n_methods} methods exist but rarely invoke each other, suggesting weak functional relationships.
rules.recommendation_template: Consider whether these methods truly belong together. If they share data (high SCPM) but don't call each other, they may represent separate responsibilities that should be split.

rules.diagnosis_template: Low functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}) with {n_components} functional groups. The module contains distinct workflows that operate independently.
rules.recommendation_template: Refactor into {n_components} separate modules to isolate each functional workflow. This will improve maintainability and testability.

rules.diagnosis_template: Low functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). The methods {disconnected_methods_str} have no invocation relationships with other methods.
rules.recommendation_template: Cross-check SCPM for {disconnected_methods_str}. If they also have low structural cohesion, they are strong candidates for extraction to separate modules.

rules.diagnosis_template: Low functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Methods have weak invocation relationships.
rules.recommendation_template: Review the module's responsibility. Methods that collaborate toward a common goal should call each other more frequently. Consider extracting unrelated methods.

rules.diagnosis_template: Moderate functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}), but {n_components} functional groups detected. Some methods collaborate while others remain isolated.
rules.recommendation_template: Evaluate whether the {n_components} groups represent distinct responsibilities. If so, extract them into separate modules to improve cohesion.

rules.diagnosis_template: Moderate functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Methods are connected through {indirect_invocations} indirect invocations (via common helper functions) and {direct_invocations} direct invocations.
rules.recommendation_template: Good use of helper functions. Consider whether additional direct collaborations between methods would improve the module's functional flow.

rules.diagnosis_template: Moderate functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Some methods collaborate through invocations, but there's room for improvement.
rules.recommendation_template: Acceptable cohesion level. Review whether all methods serve the same functional purpose. Extract any outliers.

rules.diagnosis_template: High functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Methods collaborate well through {direct_invocations} direct and {indirect_invocations} indirect invocations.
rules.recommendation_template: Excellent - methods work together toward a common functional goal. Continue maintaining this cohesive design.

rules.diagnosis_template: High functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Methods are well-connected through {indirect_invocations} shared helper functions and {direct_invocations} direct collaborations.
rules.recommendation_template: Excellent use of helper functions to promote code reuse while maintaining functional cohesion.

rules.diagnosis_template: High functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Methods have strong functional relationships through invocations.
rules.recommendation_template: Well-designed module with methods that collaborate effectively. Maintain this pattern.

rules.diagnosis_template: Excellent functional cohesion in {module_name} (FCPM: {fcpm:.2f}). Almost all methods are interconnected through invocations, demonstrating a highly cohesive functional design.
rules.recommendation_template: Optimal - this module exemplifies excellent functional cohesion with methods working as a unified, collaborative unit.
